set.approach: Use the large parking area on the right side of the canyon road, just up from the canyon entrance; the climbs are on several large boulders next to the stream. This route is at the far right of the established routes, and the belayer takes a stance on the ledge behind and over the start.

review.notes: Both pages. Lead review dropped the descent: it described reaching the top anchor, not getting down.

set.approach: Use the large parking area on the right side of the canyon road, just up from the canyon entrance; the climbs are on several large boulders next to the stream. The route has no bolts on the face and is climbed on a top rope from one of two close pairs of anchor bolts on top.

review.notes: Route page gives no location on the boulders, so only the area approach is written. No descent stated.
